text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now then. Thank you all for gathering here, team members.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then—let us depart. To deepen our bond,
to "that place" most befitting of us.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, somewhere distinct from 'that promised land'
I must reach. In other words—”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The nature of a gathering place changes depending on the Umamusume who assemble there. Ah—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can see it—the sanctuary we must head towards.
Espo-san, Loves-san,
<nickname>-san, this way...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, wait up!
Where do you think you're going, hey!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ummm...
For now, should we chase after them?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
ââ!?
Where the heck is this place?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As you can see—it's a "Garden of Thorns."
I figured Espo-san would prefer something wild, while Loves-san would like something photogenic.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It definitely gets the imagination going, doesn't it?
Shall we film a short video, then? I'll hold the camera.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A short video! Sounds lovely.
How about a "supernatural ability battle" theme?
Espo-san, please give it your absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... There you are.
Allow me to pass judgment on your sins.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For every sin, a thorn shall pierce.
One... two... thr—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So annoying!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
This crap is just a bunch of weeds!
I'll rip 'em all to shreds, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san...?
The atmosphere, please preserve the atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The short video turned into pure slapstick.
However, the members of "DREAMS"
deepened their bonds during the shoot.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can see it—the sanctuary we must head toward.
Ms. Yanko, Ms. Loves,
<nickname>, this way...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa, whoa?! Where are you going~?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ummm...
For now, should we chase after them?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a castle. Sweet, sweet!
The decorations are super detailed too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Right? Yang-ko-san and Loves-san seemed
like they'd love photogenic spots, after all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Shooting a video in a place like this
would surely rake in the views♡"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should introduce them to a streaming company I know. While I'm at it, wanna pitch Loves too?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
However, for today, rather than me...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Desire-san, since we have the chance, why don't you try being the streamer today?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A-A streamer... Um, well...
I don't really have much experience with that, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If you're inviting me...
I guess I could try... just a little bit...♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪
Have you ever felt it before, everyone?
That this isn't the world where you truly belong!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? You're more... into it than I thought?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You can see it, can't you? The utopia we ought to strive for.
Please, watch this video
all the way to the end—!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Red Desire learned
all the ins and outs of livestreaming.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can see it—the sanctuary we must head towards.
Espo-san, Marche-san,
<nickname>-san, this way...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, hey! Where are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "H-Hey, don't leave me behind~!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let us talk to our hearts' content by this mountain stream today.
Both you, Espo-san, and Marche-san.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why a river of all places... Can't be helped, I guess...
Hey, Marche. How've things been with you lately?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Eh?! U-Umm...
Maru-chan is doing great!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Now, Marche-san, closer to the water's edge.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yeah... But I wonder if I can do it with one hand.
Heave-ho... hup..."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Marche, stop spacing out!
Watch your step, your step!
As long as you keep an eye on that, you'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Eh... Ah, yeah...
Thank... you..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under Red Desire's guidance,
the distance between the two of them closed just a little.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can see it—the sanctuary we must head toward.
Ms. Yanko, Ms. Marche,
<nickname>, this way...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa, whoa?! Where are you going~?!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "H-Hey, don't leave me behind~!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a chapel-style wedding venue~!
I wonder if some startup built this.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Wow, so pretty..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's one of my favorite places too. I figured you two
might also be interested in its beautiful design.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's half-business for me rather than just interest.
Hosting viral events in places like this...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hm, huh? But the roof decoration might be improved.
Maybe make the design sleeker...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: The decorations... on the roof...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Something... like that?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
――!? Marchie~, yes, exactly like that!
Your brush is really on fire today!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, I've been meaning to ask... are you a free agent right now?
If so, wanna sign with my affiliate group?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Wha-whoa!? I-I'm happy to, but
I have to help Loves-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bridge built by design. The distance between
Forever Young and Marche Lorraine
seemed to have closed a little.
